snippet.title: Tachyon Fire Gameplay
snippet.description:
Releasing late July/ early August
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4745310/Tachyon_Fire/

Tachyon Fire is a fast-paced arena FPS inspired by the gameplay of Devil Daggers, the movement of Tribes, and the game-feel of Quake III.  Evolve your weapons using the harvested energy of your enemies. Master each level by optimizing your movement and crowd control to achieve the fastest completion time.
